expectedBehavior: A client talks in memory (InMemoryTransportPair) to an agent that pretends to be a newer ACP version. The client sends a prompt with _meta {acptutorial.dev/traceId=trace-42}; the agent's first message reports the prompt _meta it saw and carries the same _meta on the session update. A session update of the unknown kind 'usage_forecast' is kept as an UnknownSessionUpdate with its fields {tokensLeft=1200}; a message with an unknown content block type 'hologram' is kept with fields {frames=3}. The stop reason 'paused_for_review' is not known (known: false) and does not equal END_TURN; the known stop reasons are listed; the response carries the _meta back. Then raw JSON of a session/update from a newer peer is read as UnknownSessionUpdate and written back unchanged (true). Ends with '=== Demo Complete ===' and no exceptions. The unknown values are the point of the demo, not errors.
requiredOutput: message: the agent saw prompt _meta acptutorial.dev/traceId=trace-42   _meta {acptutorial.dev/traceId=trace-42}
message with an unknown content block: type 'hologram', fields {frames=3}
stop reason: paused_for_review, known: false, equals END_TURN: false
known stop reasons: [end_turn, max_tokens, max_turn_requests, refusal, cancelled]
